visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a messy grey wig and a thick fake mustache is dressed in a light grey shirt, black bowtie, and a charcoal grey blazer. He holds several blue folders against his chest and gestures with his right hand in a well-lit studio setting with a white background. (2) The scene cuts to a man with dark hair and glasses wearing a light purple shirt and a backpack, staring intensely at a black laptop with a backlit MSI logo. The lighting is focused, casting shadows behind him. (3) The first man (the boss) reappears, looking stern and pointing as he continues to hold the folders. (4) A montage of different characters played by the same man: a worker in a purple shirt on a phone, a man in a black suit on a phone looking distressed, and a man in a blonde wig on a phone. (5) A character in a full-body bright red spandex suit appears, clutching a large white heart-shaped plush pillow. He looks upwards with an expression of agony and pain. (6) The red-suited character is shown in a closer shot, looking more distressed, with shadows emphasizing the texture of the spandex. (7) The boss character returns and presents two bottles of purple Listerine mouthwash (one large, one small travel size) directly toward the camera. (8) A series of quick cuts shows the various characters from before holding the purple bottles and smiling or speaking directly to the camera. (9) A visual montage: the glasses-wearing character drinks from the bottle cap; the red-suited character is splashed with a clear liquid (mouthwash) and reacts with joy; the suit-wearing character holds his jaw then smiles. (10) The characters appear in different settings—an elevator, a couch with a teddy bear, and a bed—all holding or showing the mouthwash bottle, looking refreshed. (11) The boss character is shown on a phone call as the screen fades to black.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a loud, authoritative male voice clearing his throat, followed by a bossy demand for overtime. There is no BGM at first, emphasizing the vocal presence. (2) A fast-tempo electronic pop beat starts abruptly. The male vocal shifts to a stressed, high-pitched tone as he speaks on the phone. The drums are prominent with a driving synth bassline. (3) A loud 'thud' and metallic 'clank' sound as the boss drops folders. The music continues with high energy. (4) The vocal shifts into a series of emotional, high-frequency characters talking to their 'wife', 'son', and 'mom', with the BGM remaining steady. (5) A sudden shift to high-pitched, strained shouting from the 'red suit' character. This is followed by a comedic 'whoosh' transition SFX. (6) The BGM transitions to a more cheerful, promotional jingle style. The male voice becomes enunciated and clear, acting as a narrator for the mouthwash brand. (7) Sound of liquid splashing and bubbling (water SFX) as the music hits a bright, melodic peak. The vocal tone is now joyful and refreshed. (8) The video ends with a final comedic vocal delivery from the boss character over a fading musical trail.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedic commercial for Listerine mouthwash. It uses a series of exaggerated skits where a 'boss' character forces overtime on several workers (all played by the same actor), leading to stress and neglected oral health. The solution—Listerine—is introduced to 'cleanse' the day and provide a refreshing ending to a hard night's work.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of the product, naming the brand multiple times, and listing specific benefits like removing dental plaque.
